translations.web: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.
translations.bsb: Now the sea was growing worse and worse, so they said to Jonah, “What must we do to you to calm this sea for us?”
translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
translations.asv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea grew more and more tempestuous.
